# T-shirt print · what to bring

**Generated files (use these, not the AI mockup):**

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| **`tshirt-chest-print.png`** | **Give this to the printer.** Same artwork as reference, transparent background, 300 DPI, ~9 cm wide |
| `tshirt-chest-preview-on-black.png` | Show on your phone so they see how it looks on black fabric |
| `tshirt-reference.png` | Your approved source artwork (regenerate from this if needed) |
| `salanor-mark-teal.svg` | Vector backup if they ask for source only |

Regenerate anytime:

```bash
python docs/brand/build-tshirt-print.py
```

---

## At the shop · say this

- Black t-shirt, **1 piece**
- **Left chest**
- Print file: **`tshirt-chest-print.png`**
- Total width on shirt: **~9 cm**
- Teal logo: **#43C2A9**
- White text: **Salanor**
- **No back print. No sleeve print.**

You do **not** need the AI mockup file. You do **not** need separate logo + text unless the shop asks (then give PNG + SVG).

---

## Business card

**Yes. Just bring the PDF.**

Also say: *“Dark card, print background colours and grey text.”* Ask for **1 proof** before the full run.
